chain_provenance.scope: attack and finite chained projectile only; other source nodes retained by assembler

owned_node_mapping.EmptyAbility/EpDamage: lifecycle.parameters.native_owned_data, actually read by elemental.packet; native has no selector/clock/SP/events and is a parameter owner rather than an independent cast

source_policy.attack_frame: 37/66 at30fps, original float32 retained, maxAnimScale1 selected normalized source reference
source_policy.priority: one shared combat/attack native path; selector acquisition owns automatic attack; no general skills or SourceSkill components in this exact prefab
source_policy.EP_container: Data-only ownership projection is explicit reference representation of native EmptyAbility; no extra Buff invented, no empty cast granted; packet refuses absent/mismatched container
source_policy.selector: All native AdvancedSelector fields preserved (including postFilter4/abnormal25/combo2/exclude46). Eligibility consumes native mask/side/motion/free fields; ordering uses existing reference selection order. Native method bodies/client selection equivalence not claimed.
source_policy.movement: source WALK/.7 with independent physical and route mode; route supplied by stage
source_policy.death: literal BB child dzomg_2/delay1; immediate death plus authenticated managed delayed birth; count1 native BSON.
